The variables chosen are "Sex of respondent, 1979" (gender) and "Highest grade completed, 1979" (degree completion rates). The analysis revealed a significant difference in the mean degree completion rates between males and females, with a t-statistic of -5.69 and a p-value of approximately 1.29 × 10⁻⁸, indicating a statistically significant relationship.
